name: Garlic Butter Pasta
steps: Bring water and most of the salt to a boil. Cook spaghetti for the packet time until firm-tender.
Meanwhile thinly slice garlic and melt butter over low heat. Cook garlic for 3 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden, without letting it darken.
Reserve 200 ml pasta water and drain spaghetti. Add pasta to the garlic butter with a splash of reserved water and toss vigorously.
Add lemon juice, pepper, parsley and grated cheese off the heat. Loosen with more reserved water if needed, taste for salt and serve.
tips: Use vegetarian hard cheese and stop cooking the garlic before it turns brown and bitter.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
